e.title: CMF（智利金融市场委员会）：含「保险市场统计」的监管统计入口
e.title_en: CMF (Chile’s Financial Market Commission): regulatory statistics including an insurance market statistics section
e.title_hk: CMF（智利金融市場委員會）：含「保險市場統計」的監管統計入口
e.summary: 智利金融监管机构：统计栏目下设有「保险市场统计」专页，另有证券市场/银行统计、出版物与规范性研究系列
e.summary_en: Chile’s financial regulator: an statistics section with a dedicated insurance market statistics page, plus securities and banking statistics, publications and a normative study series
e.summary_hk: 智利金融監管機構：統計欄目下設有「保險市場統計」專頁，另有證券市場/銀行統計、出版物與規範性研究系列
e.body:
**CMF（Comisión para el Mercado Financiero，智利金融市场委员会）** 是**智利的金融监管机构**（保险、证券与银行）。本条目填补**拉丁美洲**空白——实测池内**智利、哥伦比亚、秘鲁相关条目均为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：入口页 110.7KB；**统计栏目 `/portal/estadisticas/626/…`** 下实测到**分类结构**：**「Estadísticas del Mercado de Seguros」（保险市场统计）**、**证券市场统计**、**银行与金融机构统计**、**其他实体统计**、**一般统计**、**出版物**、**机构报告（Informes Institucionales）** 与 **规范性研究系列（Serie de Estudios Normativos）**；其中**保险市场统计专页实测 200，137.5KB**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上拉美**——池内监管/数据源覆盖北美、欧洲多国、澳、东亚与东南亚，**拉美此前为零**；而智利是**拉美保险与养老金（AFP 体系）改革**的样板市场，对做**新兴市场养老金与年金化**研究的学生是直接材料（尤其养老金年金化市场，可与 [[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 对照）；**② 统计分类清晰、层级分明**——「保险市场统计」单独成页，且与证券、银行并列，**便于按板块取数**，也可与 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[philippines-insurance-commission]]、[[ira-kenya]] 一起构成**多市场横向对照**；**③ 智利的地震暴露**使其巨灾研究与 [[openquake-engine]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[opendrr-riskprofiler]]、[[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]] 直接相关（智利是全球参数险与巨灾债券的活跃市场）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 站点与统计以西班牙语为主**（本次未核实英文版）；**②** 本次核实到**栏目结构与保险市场统计专页的存在（HTTP 200、137.5KB）**，**但未打开任何数据文件或报表**，因此**不能确认数据口径、频率与可得性**；**③** 各统计页为门户式结构（路径含内部 property 编号），**深链稳定性未长期验证**；**④** 本条目**不主张**该站提供精算工具或可直接入库的机器可读数据集。**核实说明**：入口页（110.7KB）与 `/portal/estadisticas/626/w4-propertyname-620.html`（保险市场统计，137.5KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取栏目结构；**未打开任何数据文件**。
e.body_en:
**CMF (Comisión para el Mercado Financiero)** is **Chile’s financial regulator** (insurance, securities and banking). This entry fills the **Latin America** gap — a measured search found **zero entries for Chile, Colombia or Peru**. Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the entry page is 110.7KB; within the **statistics section `/portal/estadisticas/626/…`** the following structure was measured: **"Estadísticas del Mercado de Seguros" (insurance market statistics)**, **securities market statistics**, **banking and financial institution statistics**, **other entities statistics**, **general statistics**, **publications**, **institutional reports (Informes Institucionales)** and a **normative study series (Serie de Estudios Normativos)**; the **insurance market statistics page itself measured 200 at 137.5KB**.

For RIAA: **① it adds Latin America** — the corpus’s regulator and data sources cover North America, several European countries, Australia and East and Southeast Asia, while **Latin America was at zero**; and Chile is the **showcase market for Latin American insurance and pension (AFP system) reform**, making it direct material for students working on **emerging-market pensions and annuitisation** (especially the pension annuitisation market, comparable to [[retirement-planning]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]] and [[apra-superannuation-statistics]]); **② the statistics taxonomy is clear and layered** — "insurance market statistics" is its own page alongside securities and banking, which **makes sector-by-sector extraction easy** and slots into a **multi-market comparison** with [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[oecd-insurance-data]], [[mas-insurance-statistics]], [[ojk-insurance-statistics]], [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[philippines-insurance-commission]] and [[ira-kenya]]; **③ Chile’s seismic exposure** ties its catastrophe work directly to [[openquake-engine]], [[gem-global-exposure-model]], [[canada-seismic-risk-model]], [[opendrr-riskprofiler]], [[cat-bond-pricing]] and [[parametric-insurance-demo]] (Chile is an active market for parametric cover and cat bonds).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① the site and its statistics are mainly in Spanish** (no English version verified here); **②** this check verified **the section structure and the existence of the insurance market statistics page (HTTP 200, 137.5KB)** **but opened no data file or report**, so **definitions, frequency and availability cannot be confirmed**; **③** the statistics pages use a portal structure (paths containing internal property numbers), so **deep-link stability was not verified over time**; **④** this entry does **not** claim the site offers actuarial tools or directly loadable machine-readable datasets. **Verification note**: the entry page (110.7KB) and `/portal/estadisticas/626/w4-propertyname-620.html` (insurance market statistics, 137.5KB) were measured at HTTP 200 and their structure read; **no data file was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**CMF（Comisión para el Mercado Financiero，智利金融市場委員會）** 是**智利的金融監管機構**（保險、證券與銀行）。本條目填補**拉丁美洲**空白——實測池內**智利、哥倫比亞、秘魯相關條目均為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：入口頁 110.7KB；**統計欄目**下實測到分類結構：**「保險市場統計」**、**證券市場統計**、**銀行與金融機構統計**、**其他實體統計**、**一般統計**、**出版物**、**機構報告**與**規範性研究系列**；其中**保險市場統計專頁實測 200，137.5KB**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上拉美**——**拉美此前為零**；而智利是**拉美保險與養老金（AFP 體系）改革**的樣板市場，對做**新興市場養老金與年金化**研究者是直接材料（可對照 [[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]）；**② 統計分類清晰**——「保險市場統計」單獨成頁，便於按板塊取數，也可與 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[ira-kenya]] 構成多市場橫向對照；**③ 智利的地震暴露**使其巨災研究與 [[openquake-engine]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[opendrr-riskprofiler]]、[[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]] 直接相關。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① 站點與統計以西班牙語為主**；**②** 本次核實到**欄目結構與保險市場統計專頁的存在（HTTP 200、137.5KB）**，**但未打開任何數據文件或報表**；**③** 統計頁為門戶式結構（路徑含內部 property 編號），**深鏈穩定性未長期驗證**；**④** 本條目**不主張**該站提供精算工具或可直接入庫的機器可讀數據集。**核實說明**：入口頁與保險市場統計頁 HTTP 200 實測並讀取欄目結構；**未打開任何數據文件**。
